status: frozen before acquisition and fixture execution
purpose: Original Python mechanism/tool admission only; not discovery quality, Java frontend reproduction, Rust adaptation, or replacement of the independent subset evaluation.
download_policy: Official raw.githubusercontent.com only; each curl max-time 40s, no retries; record URL, exit, byte count and SHA256; no downloaded pickle.
commands_budget: Two initial upstream executions, <=60 seconds subprocess timeout each; at most one compatibility diagnostic only if failed. No retries or parameter tuning.
command_1: Isolated driver runpy.run_path of unmodified archived source, argv -c official example_query.json -d run/cache. After normal source execution, decode its records[*].features using its vocab.get_word and compare against official example_features.txt. No import AST surgery, no copied/reimplemented feature functions.
feature_comparison: Count records, feature occurrences, unique features, feature-ID and decoded value types; compare decoded ordered lines and Counter(multiset) against expected lines. Strip newline terminators only; report blanks and both mismatches, never silently sort/deduplicate expected. A non-exact order alone does not mean multiset failure. Preserve full actual/expected differences.
command_2: Unmodified archived script -d run/cache -f official example_query.json, if command1 established valid fresh cache; no caller-supplied downloaded cache.
cache_policy: Fresh run-local derived pickle cache allowed, not downloaded; exclude generated cache from research git via run-local .gitignore. Cache path and hashes retained.
inputs_policy: Use original fixture bytes; no custom AST fallback or parameter alteration; stop if required fixture/schema unusable.
expected_bounds: One tiny official supplied fixture used for corpus and query; self retrieval only, no quality claim. Zero multi-member recommendations is allowed and reported. No Java, full corpus, Rust, model, production/shared-document edits or dependency installation.
verdict: Separately report acquisition/source identity, expected feature agreement, CLI indexing/query success and output counts, warnings/errors/runtime, and untested stages.
